beets-rs v0.3.0 adds a desktop app, `beet-gui`, built with [GPUI](https://gpui.rs).

- **`beet-gui`:** browse the library with beets queries, with cover art and a sortable track table. Edit fields, play, move, write tags and remove, on one item or a selection. Plugin commands are one click away.
  - **Import page:** every `beet import` option as a form.
  - **Console:** runs any `beet` command, with buttons to answer its prompts.
  - **Configuration page:** edits `config.yaml`.
  - **Keyboard:** press F1 to list the shortcuts.

  It uses the same config and library as `beet`. Anything that changes the library runs the real `beet` command line, so it behaves exactly like `beet`. See `GUI.md` in the archive.
- **ListenBrainz playlist helpers:** the functions beets 2.14 carries for weekly playlists are ported. As in beets, no command uses them yet.
- **beets-rs is now also a library crate.** The `beet` binary is a thin wrapper around it, so other front ends can call it directly.

Every archive now holds both `beet` and `beet-gui` (`.exe` on Windows). On Linux, `beet-gui` needs a desktop session (Wayland or X11). On Windows it opens a console window next to the app for now.

Downloads are for Linux (x86_64, aarch64), macOS (Apple silicon, Intel) and Windows (x86_64). Each archive has a `.sha256` checksum.
